name: SPECTRA
tagline: Upsamples the iPhone's sparse LiDAR into dense metric depth in real time on the device.
problem: Cheap phone LiDAR is too sparse to use directly, while industrial depth sensors cost thousands of dollars, the team says.
solution: SPECTRANet, an RGB-guided depth upsampler trained on ARKitScenes, sharpens a 192×256 LiDAR map to 768×1024 along real surface edges; a SwiftUI/ARKit app runs it on-device or on a local server with A/B comparison.
demo_moment: Team-described: switch between raw LiDAR and SPECTRANet depth live, side by side.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Flicker To Flow” and “Zetic Company Challenge” among 307 submissions.
Trains and ships a real model over the weekend with a visible before/after.
Frames phone hardware as a cheap substitute for expensive sensors.

lessons: Show the model's output next to the raw input; the improvement sells itself.
